summary: Sale invoices save after removing items; cancellation supports refunds, customer credit, and unresolved payments.
highlights: Removing a sale invoice item no longer blocks saving the draft.
Cancel a sale with a recorded refund, customer credit for a later invoice, or an amount to resolve later.
Customer credit can pay later invoices; original receipts and settlement history remain intact.
Financial reports separate refunds, net collected money, and customer credit from sales.
